description: This file defines a utility class 'NotificationUtil' for handling notification-related functionalities, such as creating PendingIntent instances for notifications in an Android wearable application.

classes.name: NotificationUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods and constants for notification operations on Android wearable devices.

methods.name: getExamplePendingIntent
methods.description: Creates and returns a PendingIntent that triggers a broadcast defined by NotificationIntentReceiver, passing a message string retrieved from resources.
